Early symptoms often mimic those of common bacterial pneumonia, leading to potential misdiagnosis. Effective treatment is complicated by the ineffectiveness of standard antibiotics like cephalosporins and penicillins against Legionella, which can result in delayed therapy and severe complications, including respiratory and multi-organ failure. This case underscores the importance of maintaining clean air-conditioning systems to prevent outbreaks.
